sourcePattern: Narrow adaptation of the supplied S2 run-final.ps1 Run-Command/Run-RuleBreak pattern; exactly two fixed reviewed mutation plans, no general mutation framework

binding.preLaunchRequirement: PM must read these cumulative bindings and approve the exact two temporary diffs and finite sequence. Primary must separately grant both temporary product-file permissions and a fresh native slot for this exact subject. None is granted by this source rebind. A later cumulative subject requires explicit refreshed bindings and review; the driver performs no retarget or source adoption.
binding.guard: Mandatory ExpectedSubject must equal the source-bound ReviewedSubject before creating the run directory. A finite read-only git rev-parse --verify HEAD must then match it. The reviewed proposal hash, all listed source hashes and each unique mutation anchor are checked before product mutation.
binding.futurePermission: The supplied grant reference records primary's real explicit permissions; it does not issue them. Both temporary product permissions and the local-Go slot remain ungranted.

environmentRecording: Every native command records these explicit overrides. Runner input also records inherited environment variable names without copying secret values.

readOnlySubjectCommand.executable: Host git.exe resolved with Get-Command at the separately granted launch

sequence.phase: same-target restored green after proved withdrawal red and byte-identical restore
same-target restored green after proved authority red and byte-identical restore

finiteSerialScope.cleanupBounds: taskkill: 10 seconds, then at most 10 seconds to reap taskkill; requested-process reap: 30 seconds; stream collection: at most 30 seconds per stream. No retries.

evidenceAndSafety.archives: Exact original and mutant bytes, computed unified diff, original/mutant/restored hashes, reviewed proposal and runner, source-binding checks, raw separate Go stdout/stderr, exact argv/cwd/environment overrides, actual exit/deadline/reap/stream/timestamp/duration metadata and per-mutant proofs
evidenceAndSafety.M1: Requires the actual durable_before_install child marker with Before=50, EffectSequence=52, Sequence=53 and version-3 empty-consumer receipt; positive child reap/exit 73; unchanged Service replay through 53; then the public recovered active-v2 versus wanted empty-v3 assertion in the named failing subtest. Earlier fixture failures are not accepted as this red.
evidenceAndSafety.M2: Separately classifies the public Open refusal at the actual first frozen external-grant group (seqs 27-29), or the observed first live delegation refusal. Public Open failure never claims that delegation was reached.
evidenceAndSafety.honestOutcomes: Compile/build failure, timeout, unrelated failure, unexpected evidence shape, a target that did not run, and a genuine survived-or-masked target are distinct unproved outcomes. A zero exit is called survival only if the named target actually passed.
evidenceAndSafety.restoration: Every attempted mutant is restored with exact original bytes in finally, including partial-write and handled process errors. Both byte comparison and SHA256 equality are required before green. No second mutant can coexist with the first.
evidenceAndSafety.stopPolicy: An unproved red is restored and stops before any green/second mutant for PM ruling. A proved red permits only its same-target restored green. Failed/unproved restored green also stops. No automatic weakening or retries.
evidenceAndSafety.externalTerminationLimit: External termination of the PowerShell process cannot execute finally. Keep the parent deadline disabled and do not terminate an installed-mutant run; archived originals and interim proof remain available for PM recovery. An unreaped process explicitly prevents release of the compute slot.

observedNow.status: Cumulative private source bindings updated and risk-runner checksum captured only; not parsed or run
observedNow.scope: This private metadata rebind only. PM's prior ff-only source adoption and historical S3 CODE_READY evidence are not coder execution or new runtime proof.

checksumCommand.toolResult: Completed with the requested SHA256 record and no failure reported; numeric process exit code and duration were not exposed by the tool response
